user.title: Massimo
user.description: The Massimo server that holds your MAX! Cubes.

data_description.url: The address at which a browser opens Massimo's web UI, with its scheme and port
data_description.api_key: An API key of a Massimo user with the role integration (System settings → Users); empty for a server without users
data_description.verify_ssl: Off only for a server whose certificate it made itself

zeroconf_confirm.title: Massimo
zeroconf_confirm.description: Massimo {name} was found at {url}. Give it an API key to set it up.

data_description.api_key: An API key of a Massimo user with the role integration (System settings → Users); empty for a server without users

reauth_confirm.title: Massimo
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {url} no longer works. Give a new one.

data_description.api_key: An API key of a Massimo user with the role integration (System settings → Users); empty for a server without users

error.invalid_auth: The API key is wrong, revoked, or may not read.

abort.already_configured: This server is already set up.
abort.not_massimo: This is not a Massimo server.
abort.wrong_server: The key belongs to another server.

write_failed.message: Massimo did not carry out the command: {error}

discarded.message: The Cube discarded the command, as it does when its radio budget for the hour is spent. Try again later.

device_gone.message: Massimo no longer lists this device.

away_needs_vacation.message: Away is vacation mode, which needs a temperature and an end: use the action Massimo: Set vacation.

vacation_in_past.message: The vacation's end must lie in the future.

room_not_read.message: The room's temperatures have not been read yet.

program_needs_newer_massimo.message: Week programmes need a Massimo that tags them (the feature program_etag).

program_changed_meanwhile.message: The week programme changed since it was read, in another client, at a thermostat, or by a write still on its way. Read it again, then write.

program_copy_nothing.message: Name a room to copy from, or the days to copy a day onto.

program_copy_one_day.message: To copy onto other days, name exactly one day to copy.

program_day.message: {day} is not a weekday: monday to sunday.

program_point.message: Each switch point of {day} needs a temp and an until.

program_temp.message: {day}: {temp} is not a temperature from 4.5 to 30.5 °C in steps of 0.5.

program_time.message: {day}: {until} is not a time HH:MM later than the one before, in steps of five minutes.

program_end.message: {day}'s last switch point must end at 24:00.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: Holds a room at a temperature until an end, then goes back to its week programme.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature to hold, 4.5 to 30.5 °C in steps of 0.5.

end.name: End
end.description: When the vacation ends, rounded up to the half hour.

get_program.name: Get week programme
get_program.description: Reads a room's week programme with its tag, which a write names so that it cannot overwrite a change made meanwhile.

set_program.name: Set week programme
set_program.description: Writes days of a room's week programme, each 1 to 13 switch points, the last until 24:00.

program.name: Programme
program.description: Days by name, each a list of switch points with a temperature, temp, and the time it holds until, until: 21 until 07:00.

etag.name: Tag
etag.description: The tag the programme was read with; a programme changed since is not overwritten.

copy_program.name: Copy week programme
copy_program.description: Copies a room's week programme, or some of its days, to the rooms chosen; or one day of a room onto its other days.

source.name: From room
source.description: The room to copy from; the room itself where a day is copied onto others.

days.name: Days
days.description: The days to copy; all where none are chosen. One day where it is copied onto others.

to_days.name: Onto days
to_days.description: The days the one day chosen is copied onto.
